about_the_game:
Totjimon Islands is a roguelike deckbuilder with indirect combat control. Embark on an adventure across islands inhabited by unique creatures and build powerful combos!

You decide which cards go into your deck — but which ones appear on the board and where they land is up to chance. Still, smart strategy lets you take control of the battle! Building the right deck is the only thing you truly need to worry about.

Powerful combos are the key to victory!

You have access to 6 elemental types, each with unique cards, effects, and Toji monsters. You never know what exactly you'll encounter on your journey, so you'll need to experiment and find every possible way to grow stronger.

Level up your Toji

Your Toji constantly gain experience and become stronger. Each time they level up, you can choose a new talent, granting even more freedom to craft unique and interesting builds. Gain enough levels, and your Toji will evolve into a stronger form!

Elemental deckbuilding

You are a master of the elements, giving you the power to control them in battle. Facing an enemy that gains bonuses from your Water cards? Disable that element from appearing on the board and defeat them using another element’s power. Dual-element cards open up even more creative combos!

Journey across the islands

Between battles you must choose the path ahead. You'll encounter not only enemies, but also merchants, rest spots, and more. Planning your route is crucial — the map shows which cards and opponents you may face in each encounter.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3

  • Graphics: AMD Radeon 8500 Series 64MB or NVIDIA GeForce 3

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3

short_description: It's a roguelike deckbuilder with deckbuilding as the main focus. Set off on an adventure across islands inhabited by all kinds of monsters and build powerful combos! Discover 6 elements, over 50 monsters, and 200+ talents for them!
